not_covered.topic: Ethiopian civil conflict, Persecution of Christians in Ethiopia
not_covered.text: The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church reports that at least 60 Christians have been killed in attacks in Oromia, Ethiopia, over the last week.
The casualty toll from the massacre by unknown gunmen four days ago in Taraba State, Nigeria, increases to 62 people killed and 52 more wounded.

not_covered.topic: United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear
not_covered.text: The United States launches an airstrike against an alleged drug boat in the Caribbean Sea, killing five people.
A bomb explodes near a bridge in Cúcuta, Colombia, at the border with Venezuela, injuring four police officers.

Netherlands Public Broadcasting (NPO) withdraws the Netherlands from the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest over concerns about Israel's participation, after AVROTROS withdrew in August and NPO failed to find another broadcaster.
Four people are killed, two are missing and several homes are destroyed during floods in Haiti and the Dominican Republic.
A construction site is hit by a tornado in Kepez, Antalya, Turkey, killing four workers and injuring another.

The World Meteorological Organization reports that global concentrations of carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrous oxide reached record highs in 2025, with carbon dioxide averaging 426.8 parts per million.

Nigerian police arrest 34 foreigners, including 16 Cameroonians and 18 Nigeriens, suspected of engaging in "illicit activities" in Benue State. The commissioner opens an investigation into their immigration status.
Israelis vote to elect the 120 members of the Knesset.
